ingestion_path.IFC_TO_IMODEL_SUPPORTED_PATH: Bentley iTwin Synchronization (Connectors). Two supported options: (1) iTwin Synchronizer desktop app -> synchronize the IFC into a new iModel on iModelHub; (2) iTwin Platform Synchronization API (developer.bentley.com/apis/synchronization) with the IFC connector -> create/populate the iModel in the cloud. Content rephrased for licensing compliance.
ingestion_path.why_no_direct_ifc: The frontend uses @itwin/web-viewer-react <Viewer authClient iTwinId iModelId>. Installed @itwin packages are frontend/viewer + imodels-access + imodels-client-management ONLY. There is NO IFC connector, iModel transformer, or backend authoring tool in this repo. The viewer opens an EXISTING iModel by id; it cannot convert IFC.
ingestion_path.post_ingestion_viewer_wiring: Once the demo iModel exists, the viewer opens it by pointing VITE_BENTLEY_IMODEL_ID (and VITE_BENTLEY_ITWIN_ID if a different iTwin) at the new demo iModel — a config change, NOT a code change. The engineering fixture id is retained separately.
